theme_and_archetype.rationale: High-visibility command center feel for quick POS actions in a dark snooker environment. Dark Obsidian background with vibrant snooker green accents for active tables.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing inside containers. Tactical grid.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
spacing_and_layout.alignment_rules: Left-align data/forms. Center-align empty states. Optical alignment for icons.

component_guidelines.navigation_header: Solid bg-[#0A0A0A] with 1px border-b border-zinc-800. Sticky positioning with z-50. Must show 'South Point Snooker Academy'. Navigation visible on desktop.
component_guidelines.table_cards: Flat solid background with 1px border. Highlight running state with inner glow or primary color border.
component_guidelines.buttons: High contrast. Primary action (Open Table): bg-[#10B981] text-[#0A0A0A]. Secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white. Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981].
component_guidelines.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Solid dark background. No glassmorphism.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and cards must have transition-colors duration-200.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons for Table Status, Snacks, Billing, etc.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js or .jsx extensions for all React components, NOT .tsx.
CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dialogs, forms). Use kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='open-table-btn').
Ensure Shadcn UI components are installed and customized to match the Dark/Green performance archetype.
Implement responsive grids. The POS will be used on mobile browsers by cashiers, so modal inputs and table cards must be fully usable on small screens.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for main layout structures; use Shadcn strictly for interactive logic (Dialogs, Dropdowns, Tabs).
Format all currency values using ₹ (INR) symbol.
Ensure table cards actively show running timers and current bill calculated dynamically.
